# ttfx

> Terminal text effects as a CLI, a Node API, and WebAssembly for the browser.
> One fast fx engine (Rust) renders 37 effects with byte-identical frames on
> every platform: static binary, napi Node binding, and a wasm Session that
> paints packed cells straight to canvas. No terminal emulator, no ANSI
> parsing on the web path.

## Docs

- [Install](/#install): `npx ttfx-js`, `npm i -g ttfx-js`, `npm i ttfx-node`
- [CLI reference](/cli.html): usage, terminal options, per-effect flags, `--palette`/`--bands`
- [Node API](/node.html): `play`, `getFrames`, `listEffects`, `stripAnsi`
- [Web](/web.html): `ttfx-node/web` entry, `playOnCanvas`, raw `Session`
- [All 37 effects](/effects.html): names, descriptions, copy-paste CLI commands

## Install

```sh
npx ttfx-js decrypt            # CLI, no install; pipe text in
npm i -g ttfx-js               # global: ttfx and ttfx-js commands
npm i ttfx-node                # Node API + browser entry
```

## CLI

```sh
<producer> | ttfx [terminal options] <effect> [effect options]
ttfx --help                    # all 37 effects and terminal options
ttfx <effect> --help           # options for one effect
ttfx --random-effect           # surprise me (--include-effects / --exclude-effects)
echo "hello" | ttfx beams
git log --oneline -10 | ttfx matrix
```

Terminal options go before the effect name: `--seed` (deterministic runs),
`--canvas-width/--canvas-height`, `--frame-rate`, `--tab-width`, `--wrap-text`,
`--no-color`, `--xterm-colors`, `--terminal-background-color`,
`--existing-color-handling`, `--input-file`, `--print-completion bash|zsh`.
Effect options go after it. `--palette HEX,..` + `--bands` themes the word in
field stripes (crest, hover, lit, mid, dim).

## Effects (37)

beams, binarypath, blackhole, bouncyballs, bubbles, burn, colorshift, crumble,
decrypt, errorcorrect, expand, fireworks, highlight, laseretch, matrix,
middleout, orbittingvolley, overflow, pour, print, rain, randomsequence,
rings, scattered, slice, slide, smoke, spotlights, spray, swarm, sweep,
synthgrid, thunderstorm, unstable, vhstape, waves, wipe.

Each effect takes its own options — see `ttfx <effect> --help` or the
[effects page](/effects.html).

## Node API (ttfx-node)

```js
import { play, getFrames, listEffects } from 'ttfx-node';

await play('Deploy complete', 'decrypt');               // animates the terminal
const frames = getFrames('hi', 'beams', { seed: 1 });   // string[] of ANSI frames
const tuned = getFrames('hi', 'decrypt', {
  seed: 1, effectArgs: ['--typing-speed', '5'],           // any effect flag, CLI-validated
});
```

- `getFrames(input, effect, opts?)`: sync, deterministic per `seed` (virtual
  clock; terminal size never read). Options: `seed`, `frameRate` (default 60),
  `canvasWidth`, `canvasHeight`, `tabWidth` (default 4), `wrapText`,
  `noColor`, `xtermColors`, `maxFrames` (default 10000, hard max 100000),
  `randomEffect`, `includeEffects`, `excludeEffects`, `effectArgs`.
- `play(input, effect, opts?)`: hides/restores the cursor, paces at
  `frameRate`; prints plain final text under `NO_COLOR`/pipes; rejects with
  code `INTERRUPTED` on Ctrl-C after restoring the cursor.
- `listEffects()`: all 37 effect names. `stripAnsi(s)`: strip escapes.
- Errors: `NO INPUT.` for blank input; CLI error text for unknown effects,
  invalid flags, oversized input/canvas.

## Web (ttfx-node/web)

```js
import init, { playOnCanvas, listEffects } from 'ttfx-node/web';

await init(); // loads the wasm once
console.log(listEffects().length); // 37

const anim = playOnCanvas(canvas, 'Ship it', 'decrypt', {
  seed: 7,
  palette: '#daecc6,#bbdd97,#9ece6a,#678549,#39482e',
  bands: true,
});
await anim.done;
anim.cancel(); // stop early
```

- Same vocabulary as Node `play` where it applies: `seed`, `frameRate`,
  `canvasWidth`, `canvasHeight`, plus `palette`, `background`, `bands`.
- Painter opts: `font`, `cellPx`, `transparent`.
- Raw engine: `Session` (`new`/`step`/`fill`/`width`/`height`/`free`),
  `effect_catalog()`, `field_band_index()`, `paintFrame()`.
- `fill(symbols, fg, bg, flags)`: packed cell buffers (u32 symbols, 24-bit
  RGB, u8 flags with HIDDEN=32). Serve the `wasm/` files beside the bundle;
  dynamic-import the entry to keep it out of SSR bundles.

## Determinism and parity

Same input + seed + options = byte-identical frames on CLI, Node, and web
(virtual clock; terminal size never read by the headless paths). CI asserts
CLI `--parity-dump` == `getFrames` per OS, and the wasm smoke drives
`Session`/`step`/`fill` headlessly.

- npm API: https://www.npmjs.com/package/ttfx-node
